bulletins.title: Adrian invokes fear amongst Cohort 2 with Confirmation Viva Timeline.
bulletins.summary: Adrian reportedly highlights that month-18 is the target, while month-24 is understood to be the outer limit. Not passing by then may, depending on the regulations at each institution, mean graduating with an MPhil instead. Check the official rules.
bulletins.body:
Polly seems to suggest that at Royal Holloway, month-18 may be treated as a harder deadline than at Surrey.

A Surrey CDT researcher understands that both the written Confirmation Report and the Viva are meant to be completed around month-18.

The legendary Carolina says it how it is: she will be sending out more confirmation info post briefing. Panel of examiners will be consulted with supervisors as part of the process.

Sylwia jumps on the  bandwagon by adding: "Surrey researchers have to complete a compulsory/mandatory doctoral college session on preparing for the confirmation process".

CDT Brief editors believe that this preamble information could of been better explained prior to today's session, especially with specifics for both institutions and the process. The briefing could of been a quick recap/overview with additional question handling. However, CDT researchers and academics need some reason to come to the office right?

bulletins.title: Cohort 3 not in briefing, lucky them.
bulletins.summary: Sylwia warms up for Adrian who claims CDT researchers are "always important to us". Editors of the CDT Brief wonder if this hints toward a retrospective stipend update to prior cohorts.... yeah right.

bulletins.title: Initial turn out for the morning briefing is initially sparse.
bulletins.summary: Do academics and PhD researchers understand what a start time is? Or are all events expected to start 10 minutes late with a mad cram towards the end as speakers run out of time?
